items.html: *And you must know that the ten Sefirot of the female occupy the entire length of ZA, except that it divides into two halves: in the upper half Leah is clothed, and the lower half is Rachel. And the reason: for Leah is the Achoraim of Tevuna, and she became internal relative to the head of Rachel, and she is clothed in her. Therefore the entire upper half of Rachel is called by the name of Leah. Understand this greatly.
